events.title: Dover stock holds above $200 as Q2 2026 earnings and new acquisition shape outlook
events.summary: Dover Corp. stock is trading above $200 after reporting solid Q2 2026 results, with revenue of $2.19 billion and earnings per share of $2.74, slightly exceeding expectations. The company also announced the acquisition of India-based Leistung Engineering to expand its international footprint. Analysts have set price targets suggesting a significant upside, indicating confidence in Dover's operational and earnings plans despite some recent stock price consolidation.

articles.headline: Dover stock holds above $200 as Q2 2026 earnings and new acquisition shape outlook

events.title: Nike, Target, Amer Sports + More Companies Have Gotten Tariff Refunds — Will Shoppers See Them Too?
events.summary: Several major companies, including Nike, Target, and Amer Sports, have received significant tariff refunds due to reciprocal duties that were imposed last year and later ruled illegal. While these companies are benefiting, consumers who paid higher prices due to the tariffs are questioning if they will also receive refunds, with some lawsuits already filed against companies like Costco and Nike. The U.S. Customs and Border Protection is only processing refunds for registered importers, and it remains unclear how consumer-related lawsuits will be resolved.

articles.headline: Nike, Target, Amer Sports + More Companies Have Gotten Tariff Refunds — Will Shoppers See Them Too?

events.title: Resilient Starbucks stock holds above $106 as Q3 earnings beat supports FY 2026 outlook
events.summary: Starbucks stock is trading above $106 following strong fiscal 2026 third-quarter earnings that surpassed expectations, despite a slight revenue decline due to the China divestiture. The company raised its full-year comparable sales guidance and maintained EPS guidance, reinforcing investor confidence in its growth trajectory. While the stock's valuation is considered rich, its digital engagement and loyalty programs are key drivers for sustained growth and profitability.

articles.headline: Resilient Starbucks stock holds above $106 as Q3 earnings beat supports FY 2026 outlook

events.title: Skyworks Solutions stock edges higher as Q3 earnings beat but growth stays muted
events.summary: Skyworks Solutions' Q3 2026 earnings surpassed forecasts, with diluted EPS at $1.08 against an expected $1.03, primarily due to cost discipline rather than revenue growth, which declined year over year. The stock is trading in the upper-$60 range, showing a modest 6.3% year-to-date gain, and analysts project limited upside of about 10.1% from current levels. Future performance is expected to depend on the adoption of Wi-Fi 7 and advanced RF solutions driving renewed revenue growth for the chipmaker.

articles.headline: Skyworks Solutions stock edges higher as Q3 earnings beat but growth stays muted

events.title: FedEx stock trades close to consensus target as investors eye freight-driven growth
events.summary: FedEx stock is currently trading in the high $320s, with analysts setting a consensus price target of $350.54, indicating a moderate upside. The company's freight and logistics strategy, including partnerships in autonomous trucking, is highlighted as a key driver for future growth and efficiency. Investors are watching to see if FedEx can meet or exceed this target through operational improvements and strategic deployments.

articles.headline: FedEx stock trades close to consensus target as investors eye freight-driven growth

events.title: Quest Diagnostics stock hits a fresh high as Q2 earnings beat expectations
events.summary: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) stock has reached a new 52-week high in August 2026, extending its rally after reporting strong second-quarter earnings that surpassed expectations. The company recorded $3.04 billion in revenue, a 10.2% year-over-year increase, and exceeded full-year EPS guidance, demonstrating robust operational execution and improved profitability. This performance has led to positive market momentum, with the stock trading near its peak and analysts maintaining a "Moderate Buy" consensus.

articles.headline: Quest Diagnostics stock hits a fresh high as Q2 earnings beat expectations

events.title: Aurora Cannabis acquires UK pharma firms for £2.1 million
events.summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. has acquired Internode Pharma Limited and HAP Pharma Limited, two UK-based pharmaceutical firms, for £2.1 million in cash. This acquisition provides Aurora with direct control over the medical cannabis supply chain in the UK, including a licensed import and distribution facility and a virtual pharmacy. The transaction is expected to enhance Aurora's adjusted EBITDA through operational efficiencies and reduced reliance on third-party distributors.

articles.headline: Aurora Cannabis acquires UK pharma firms for £2.1 million

events.title: Aurora Cannabis Furthers Global Medical Cannabis Growth with Accretive Acquisition of Internode Pharma Limited and HAP Pharma Limited, Expanding Distribution Access to the UK Medical Cannabis Market
events.summary: Aurora Cannabis has acquired Internode Pharma Limited and HAP Pharma Limited to expand its presence and distribution capabilities in the rapidly growing UK medical cannabis market. This strategic acquisition is expected to streamline the supply chain, enhance operational efficiencies, and contribute to Aurora's adjusted EBITDA in future quarters. The move is aimed at strengthening Aurora's leadership in the international medical cannabis sector and improving product supply to UK patients.

articles.headline: Aurora Cannabis Furthers Global Medical Cannabis Growth with Accretive Acquisition of Internode Pharma Limited and HAP Pharma Limited, Expanding Distribution Access to the UK Medical Cannabis Market

events.summary: Occidental Petroleum's stock is holding near $60 following a strong earnings beat and supportive analyst targets. The company reported EPS of $2.40 against an estimate of $1.83, with revenue rising 53.4% year-over-year. events.title: Waters stock slips after earnings beat and guidance holds
events.summary: Waters Corp (WAT) stock experienced a slight dip despite beating earnings expectations for the latest quarter, reporting $1.65 billion in revenue and $3.05 EPS against an expected $1.62 billion and $3.01 respectively. The company also issued Q3 and FY 2026 EPS guidance, which, while competitive, did not prevent the stock from trading lower. The market's focus remains on whether Waters can sustain growth and improve its narrow profitability margins, especially given its high P/E ratio.

articles.headline: Waters stock slips after earnings beat and guidance holds

events.title: Private Equity's Return to Oil, Gas and Coal Already Tops All of 2025, Driven by One $9.7B Deal
events.summary: Private equity investments in the oil, gas, and coal sectors have significantly surpassed the total for all of 2025, largely due to a $9.7 billion acquisition by KKR & Co. and Energy Capital Partners. This surge, totaling $14.7 billion through July, is attributed to rising commodity prices, energy supply concerns, and increased electricity demand from data centers and AI. Europe accounted for the majority of this investment as it seeks to reduce reliance on Russian natural gas.

articles.headline: Private Equity's Return to Oil, Gas and Coal Already Tops All of 2025, Driven by One $9.7B Deal

events.title: Is ONEOK (OKE) Fully Valued On Strong Q2 Earnings And A Higher 2026 Outlook?
events.summary: ONEOK (OKE) recently hit a 52-week high after strong Q2 earnings, an updated 2026 outlook, and a higher price target from Morgan Stanley. Despite this, Simply Wall St's analysis suggests the stock is currently 2% overvalued with a fair value of $95.48 against its last close of $97.07. While its P/E ratio is below the fair ratio and peer average, it remains above the industry level, leading to a mixed valuation outlook.

articles.headline: Is ONEOK (OKE) Fully Valued On Strong Q2 Earnings And A Higher 2026 Outlook?

events.title: Elevance Health stock trades around $400 as Q2 2026 earnings beat supports upbeat outlook
events.summary: Elevance Health stock is trading around $400, supported by a strong Q2 2026 earnings beat with adjusted EPS of $7.45 against a $6.21 consensus. The company reported modest revenue growth, but profit expansion outpaced top-line growth, leading to an upbeat full-year EPS forecast of $27.07 for 2026. Analysts maintain a "Buy to Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $440.90, indicating potential upside despite a slight membership decline.

articles.headline: Elevance Health stock trades around $400 as Q2 2026 earnings beat supports upbeat outlook

events.title: Goldman Sachs reiterates Progressive stock rating on July earnings beat
events.summary: Goldman Sachs has reiterated its Buy rating and $230.00 price target for Progressive Corp. (NYSE:PGR) after the company reported strong July operating results, beating analyst estimates for earnings per share and net premiums written growth. The insurance company's Personal Auto segment showed robust performance with an 86.7% combined ratio, and InvestingPro's Fair Value analysis suggests the stock is currently undervalued. This positive outlook comes despite recent broader market concerns about slowing policy growth and competitive pressures in the auto insurance sector.

articles.headline: Goldman Sachs reiterates Progressive stock rating on July earnings beat

events.title: Citi Turns Bullish on Zambia Debt as Election Heralds Upgrades
events.summary: Citigroup Inc. is taking a bullish stance on Zambia's bonds following the recent election of President Hakainde Hichilema, anticipating credit upgrades for the copper-producing nation. Citi strategists recommend buying Zambia's domestic seven-year notes at an upcoming auction and are going overweight on the country's credit. This outlook suggests renewed confidence in Zambia's economic future after the political transition.

articles.headline: Citi Turns Bullish on Zambia Debt as Election Heralds Upgrades

events.title: Strong ONEOK stock trades near a new 52-week high as guidance and demand support the rally
events.summary: ONEOK Inc. (OKE) stock is trading near its 52-week high in mid-August 2026, driven by strong Q2 2026 earnings, increased full-year guidance, and growing demand for natural gas from AI data centers. The company reported a 13% increase in net income and a 7% rise in adjusted EBITDA in Q2, leading to an upward revision of its 2026 outlook. Analysts have reacted positively, with some raising price targets, as the stock has significantly outperformed the market year-to-date with a gain of over 30%.

articles.headline: Strong ONEOK stock trades near a new 52-week high as guidance and demand support the rally

events.title: Morgan Stanley downgrades Diamondback Energy stock rating on valuation
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has downgraded Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ:FANG) from Overweight to Equalweight, setting a price target of $216.00, citing valuation concerns despite the company being a premier U.S. shale operator. Analyst Devin McDermott noted that the stock's valuation is in-line with peers but offers less free cash flow growth, with spending expected to rise in 2027. This downgrade comes even as Diamondback Energy recently reported strong Q2 2026 results and has seen a 42% gain year-to-date, trading near its 52-week high.

articles.headline: Morgan Stanley downgrades Diamondback Energy stock rating on valuation

events.title: Tariff refunds of nearly $1B help Target beat Street in strong Q2
events.summary: Target (TGT) reported strong second-quarter results, driven by nearly $1 billion in tariff refunds and the continued success of its turnaround program. The company's net earnings doubled and adjusted EPS significantly beat Wall Street estimates. Target also raised its full-year guidance, reflecting confidence in its strategic initiatives and continued growth in sales.

articles.headline: Tariff refunds of nearly $1B help Target beat Street in strong Q2

events.title: Morgan Stanley downgrades Diamondback Energy stock rating on valuation By Investing.com
events.summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ:FANG) from Overweight to Equalweight due to valuation concerns, setting a price target of $216.00. Analyst Devin McDermott noted that the company's valuation is in line with peers despite offering less free cash flow growth and that future capital spending on the Barnett play may increase in 2027. Despite the downgrade, Diamondback Energy has seen a 42% year-to-date gain and recently reported strong Q2 2026 results, surpassing analyst expectations.

articles.headline: Morgan Stanley downgrades Diamondback Energy stock rating on valuation By Investing.com

events.title: Why Edison International (EIX) Is Up 5.4% After Q2 Earnings Beat And Reaffirmed 2026 Guidance
events.summary: Edison International (EIX) saw its stock rise 5.4% after reporting Q2 2026 earnings above analyst forecasts and reaffirming its full-year guidance of US$5.90 to US$6.20 per share. Despite these positive results and a lifted annual dividend, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating due to ongoing wildfire and regulatory risks in California. The company's investment narrative hinges on regulated grid investment and electrification outweighing these persistent challenges, with wildfire cost recovery clarity remaining a key short-term catalyst.

articles.headline: Why Edison International (EIX) Is Up 5.4% After Q2 Earnings Beat And Reaffirmed 2026 Guidance
